作品 / THE COLLECTION

One block.
One night.

Every token is a six-second night drawn by the contract from the block it was minted in. You can’t choose it, and nobody can make it twice.

  1. 01

    Mint captures a moment

    Your transaction lands in one Ethereum block. That block number becomes your token, and only the first mint in each block succeeds. There is nothing to pick and nothing to upload.

  2. 02

    The block becomes a seed

    The block’s own onchain information is hashed into a seed. It decides which night you get and everything inside it: the signs, which windows are lit, where the rain falls, the light and the rhythm.

  3. 03

    Drawn whenever it’s read

    No image is stored. The contract renders the animation in Solidity on every read and returns the original GIF in the token’s metadata. Ask again in a decade and it draws the same night.

Eight kinds of night

Each seed falls into one of eight settings. Seven are equally likely; one is rare.

  • 峡谷 CanyonGliding down a megacity street canyon, past towers of neon.
  • 地下 DescentRiding the front of a train down a deep subway tunnel.
  • 高架 MonorailAn elevated line through the city under a sodium-orange haze.
  • 摩天楼 SpireOne slow orbit around an octagonal megatower.
  • 夜景 SkylineA flyover above the towers and a pink sea of fog.
  • 路地 AlleyA wet lane of neon signs, paper lanterns and a vending machine.
  • 夜行 Night trainAn angled window onto passing towers, rails and wires.
  • 里山 SatoyamaRare, about 1 in 64. A snow peak, a maglev viaduct, a torii and drifting cherry petals.

概要 / A MOMENT, KEPT

The chain keeps moving.
Your night stays.

Minting captures the block your transaction lands in. Its own onchain information becomes a seed for one of eight animated worlds. No numbers to choose. No images to upload.

The art lives in the contract. Every pixel, colour and frame is generated in Solidity whenever it’s read. Your block becomes a six-second loop. Yours to keep.
